name: VT-Simple Trainer EPP RTF (Ready-To-Fly)
tagline: Durable Full-EPP beginners trainer with Carbon Fiber reinforcement.
summary: Made of full EPP, reinforced with Carbon Fiber, this ultra lightweight Trainer plane is an ideal Trainer or Beginners RC plane.
description: The Super Trainer EPP is designed specifically for first-time builders and flyers. Constructed from highly impact-resistant EPP foam and reinforced with structural carbon fiber strips, this plane can survive crashes that would destroy conventional balsa or EPO models. Its high-wing configuration makes it extremely stable and self-righting in flight, giving beginners the confidence they need to learn aeromodelling.
features: Full EPP Foam Construction - Highly Crash Resistant & Easy to Repair
Carbon Fiber reinforced Wing Spars and Fuselage
Easy Build Level - Ideal for first time builders
Stable High-Wing configuration with dihedral self-righting physics
Complete hardware pack including pushrods, linkages, landing gear, and EPP wheels
whatsInTheBox: EPP Fuselage Middle Section & 2x Printed Side Walls
2x 600mm EPP Wing Panels with carbon slotting
EPP Printed Horizontal and Vertical Stabilizers
Pushrods (2x 600mm each) with 5x Guides & 2x Linkage Connectors
Landing Gear Wire with 2x EPP Wheels & 4x Collars
Velcro, Bamboo Skewers, and Rubber Bands

name: FT-Viggen Aircraft
tagline: Use your own transmitter, receiver, battery, and charger.
summary: For experienced pilots with their own radio system. Includes factory-installed motor, ESC, digital servos, and VT-Stabilize flight board.
description: The PNP edition of the VT-Simple Trainer is built for experienced pilots or club flyers who already own a 2.4GHz transmitter and receiver system. It ships fully assembled with motor, ESC, servos, and gyro stabilization pre-installed. Just plug in your 4+ channel receiver and 3S LiPo battery to take off.
whatsInTheBox: VT-Simple Trainer Airframe (assembled with ESC, Motor, Servos)

name: P-51D Mustang
tagline: Classic WWII fighter with scale details and superb sport flight performance.
summary: Scale model of the legendary P-51D Mustang, built with durable EPP foam and high-performance brushless electronics.
description: Take to the skies with the legendary P-51D Mustang. This model features scale lines, pre-installed motor, ESC, and servos. Perfect for pilots looking for a scale warbird with docile flight characteristics and high speed potential.
features: Authentic scale WWII paint scheme and decals
Robust EPP foam construction with carbon spars
Fully functional control surfaces (Ailerons, Elevator, Rudder)

name: Spitfire |  WW2 Fighter Aircraft | Britannica
tagline: The legendary British fighter with elliptical wings and agile flight performance.
summary: High-fidelity replica of the Supermarine Spitfire, featuring authentic elliptical wings and responsive brushless power.
description: Rule the skies with the iconic Supermarine Spitfire. Engineered with a scale elliptical wing profile and built from crash-resistant EPP foam, this model offers outstanding agility and speed for intermediate to advanced pilots.
features: Durable EPP foam structure with carbon reinforcements
Full 4-channel control setup (Ailerons, Elevator, Rudder, Throttle)

name: FT-Guinea Pig
tagline: Twin-motor cargo utility aircraft designed for heavy payloads.
summary: Durable twin-engine cargo transport model, ideal for dropping parachutes, candy, or carrying cameras.
description: The FT-Guinea Pig is a versatile twin-engine utility cargo plane. Built to carry payloads, it can easily handle cargo drops or FPV gear. The high wings and twin motors provide high lift and stability.
features: Generous internal cargo bay with functional ramp

name: FT-Storch
tagline: Legendary scale STOL aircraft with short takeoff and landing physics.
summary: Highly scale replica of the Fieseler Fi 156 Storch, offering incredible short-field performance and stable slow flight.
description: Enjoy majestic scale flights with the FT-Storch. Featuring functional flaps and slats options, it can take off and land in extremely tight spaces, making it a joy to fly in small parks.
features: Functional flap options for extreme STOL flights

name: FT-Explorer
tagline: Pusher-prop modular trainer ideal for beginner pilots and FPV cameras.
summary: Rear-mounted pusher propeller platform, keeping the motor and camera protected in case of rough landings.
description: The FT-Explorer is a versatile, modular trainer aircraft. The pusher configuration shields the propeller and motor, making it extremely durable for beginners and a perfect choice for FPV setups.
features: Pusher prop setup for motor protection
Modular nose design for camera mounts

name: FT-Spear
tagline: High-speed FPV flying wing with huge internal payload compartment.
summary: Fast, agile flying wing offering a massive battery bay and dedicated slots for action cameras.
description: The FT-Spear is a delta flying wing designed for speed, agility, and long-range FPV. With a cavernous payload bay, you can carry multiple batteries, flight controllers, and cameras with ease.

name: FT-22 Raptor
tagline: Tactical foam board park jet with fighter jet looks and easy handling.
summary: Highly maneuverable replica of the F-22 Raptor fighter jet, offering excellent park jet performance.
description: Experience jet fighter aerobatics with the FT-22 Raptor. Constructed from durable foam board, it is incredibly easy to build and fly, offering amazing slow-speed control and high-speed passes.
features: Wide speed envelope from slow to fast flights

name: Old Fogey
tagline: Vintage-style slow flyer with nostalgic looks and slow stable flight.
summary: Classic high-dihedral vintage flyer that can literally fly at walking speed. Perfect for backyard flying.
description: Enjoy the charm of classic aviation with the Old Fogey. Designed for slow and stable flights, this model features massive wings with huge dihedral, making it incredibly self-righting and forgiving. Ideal for flying in small fields, parks, or even backyards on calm days.
features: Extremely slow and stable flight physics
Highly crash-resistant and easy-to-build foam construction

name: Bloody Baron
tagline: High-performance sport flyer and combat aircraft with vertical climb capability.
summary: Extremely versatile 4-channel sport flyer and streamer combat plane with wide speed range.
description: Constructed from laser-cut foam board, the Bloody Baron is a compact, high-performance sport flyer. It can be built as a simple 3-channel trainer or a fully aerobatic 4-channel beast. Excellent for streamer combat, it offers vertical climbs and tight loops.
features: Wide flight envelope with great high-speed and vertical performance

name: VT-Simple Trainer Replacement Wing Assembly
tagline: Factory original main wing set with carbon spars.
summary: Complete replacement main wing with factory pre-cut decals and pre-installed carbon fiber reinforcement.
description: Accidents happen during training. Keep flying with genuine factory replacement main wings engineered to match original aerodynamic specs.
features: Pre-installed internal dual carbon fiber spars

name: VT Wireless RC Flight Simulator USB Dongle
tagline: Practice in virtual skies on your PC or Mac before real-world flight.
summary: Connect your VT-6X transmitter wirelessly to your computer to master landings and maneuvers in RealFlight and Phoenix simulators.
description: Build muscle memory risk-free. Plugs into any USB-A or USB-C port and binds seamlessly with your radio.
features: Zero latency 2.4GHz receiver inside USB stick
Plug & Play compatibility with Windows 10/11 and macOS
